description: List all projects in LightTasks with their id, name, color, and description.

returns.description: Object with status and a list of project records.

description: Create a new project in LightTasks.

returns.description: Object with status and the created project record.

description: Delete a project. Tasks belonging to the project are moved to reassign_to (defaults to proj_inbox).

reassign_to.description: Project id that receives the tasks (default proj_inbox).

returns.description: Object with status and the count of reassigned tasks.

description: List tasks in LightTasks with optional filters by project, status, priority, tag, and assignee.

project_id.description: Restrict to a single project id.

status.description: One of todo, in_progress, done, cancelled.

priority.description: One of low, medium, high, critical.

tag.description: Only tasks that contain this tag.

assignee.description: Only tasks assigned to this user identifier.

returns.description: Object with status and a list of task summaries.

description: Fetch the full record for a single task by id.

returns.description: Object with status and the full task record.

description: Create a new task in a project.

priority.description: One of low, medium, high, critical.

due_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or empty for no due date.

returns.description: Object with status and the created task summary.

description: Update any subset of fields on a task. Only fields provided are changed.

status.description: One of todo, in_progress, done, cancelled.

priority.description: One of low, medium, high, critical.

project_id.description: Move task to this project id.

returns.description: Object with status and the updated task summary.

description: Permanently delete a task by id.

returns.description: Object with status and a deleted flag.

description: Mark a task as done. Shortcut for update_task(status=done).

returns.description: Object with status and the updated task summary.

description: Set a task back to todo. Shortcut for update_task(status=todo).

returns.description: Object with status and the updated task summary.

description: Move a task to a different project.

returns.description: Object with status and the updated task summary.

description: Add a tag to a task. No-op if the tag is already present.

returns.description: Object with status and the updated task summary.

description: Remove a tag from a task. No-op if the tag is not present.

returns.description: Object with status and the updated task summary.

description: Case-insensitive substring search across task titles, descriptions, and tags.

returns.description: Object with status and a list of matching task summaries.

description: List not-done tasks with a due date between today and today+days.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default 7).

returns.description: Object with status and a list of task summaries.

description: List not-done tasks whose due_date is strictly before today.

returns.description: Object with status and a list of overdue task summaries.

description: Aggregate task counts grouped by status, priority, and project.

returns.description: Object with status and aggregated counters.
